frequency_question: How often does a state establish a domestic manufacturing line for a foreign precision-guided missile system within a sub-two-month timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes any documented program where a nation transitioned a licensed or reverse-engineered complex cruise/ballistic missile from foreign blueprints to domestic factory floor assembly.

cases.name: Pakistani Babur cruise missile domestic production
Ukrainian Neptune missile series production ramp

provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: Exhaustive for rapid domestic adaptation of foreign cruise missile systems.
known_gaps: Classified bilateral defense agreements might have expedited minor sub-component assembly, but full line establishment has zero historical precedent in under two months.
skeleton: No historical cases exist of establishing a complex jet-powered cruise missile manufacturing and testing facility from scratch in 49 days; standard industrial tooling, supply chain synchronization, and safety/guidance testing cycles require a minimum of 18 to 36 months.
multiplier: 49 days available vs 540-1080 days required minimum for physical tooling and integration.
validity_reason: Industrial manufacturing timelines and physics of precision machining change slowly.
